question: Five years ago, Meera was three times as old as her niece, Kavya. Seven years from now, Meera will be twice as old as Kavya. What is Meera’s current age (in years)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let present ages be M and K

5 years ago: M − 5 = 3(K − 5)

7 years later: M + 7 = 2(K + 7)

Solving quickly ⇒ K = 17, M = 41

**∴ Answer = 41 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let present age of Meera = M

Let present age of Kavya = K

5 years ago: M − 5 = 3 × (K − 5)

7 years from now: M + 7 = 2 × (K + 7)

**Formula used:**

Linear equations: solve simultaneous equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ M − 5 = 3K − 15

⇒ M = 3K − 10

⇒ M + 7 = 2K + 14

⇒ M = 2K + 7

⇒ 3K − 10 = 2K + 7

⇒ K = 17

⇒ M = 2K + 7 = 41

**∴ The correct answer is 41 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Equation Concept

Translate time-based conditions into equations.

Simultaneous Equations

Solve equations to determine unknown ages.

Verification

Check values satisfy both given conditions.
